fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Normalized event timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format
fields.justification: Enables chronological sorting and time-range queries across all sources in 3x02 detections and 3x03 triage

source_mapping.linux_text: syslog timestamp or auditd epoch converted to ISO 8601 UTC
source_mapping.network_csv: epoch seconds column converted to ISO 8601 UTC
source_mapping.network_json: timestamp or start_time field converted to ISO 8601 UTC

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Hostname of the system that generated the event
fields.justification: Allows analysts to filter events by host and correlate activity across sources during triage

source_mapping.linux_text: parsed hostname from syslog header or auditd hostname field

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Origin source category of the event such as windows_json, linux_text, firewall, suricata_alert, or pcap_flow
fields.justification: Lets downstream queries filter by telemetry source without inspecting raw fields

source_mapping.network_json: suricata for alert events, pcap_flow for flow summaries

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level category of the event such as authentication, process, file, network, network_alert, network_flow, audit, or powershell
fields.justification: Needed by 3x02 detection rules and 3x03 triage filters to group events independently of source vendor

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity level of the event: info, low, medium, high, or critical
fields.justification: Enables prioritization of alerts in 3x03 triage and threshold-based detection in 3x02

source_mapping.linux_text: derived from audit_type and res field (failed=medium, success=info)
source_mapping.network_json: alert.severity field for suricata, constant: info for pcap

fields.name: user
fields.description: Username associated with the event if present
fields.justification: Critical for correlating user activity across hosts and detecting lateral movement in 3x02

source_mapping.linux_text: parsed user field from syslog or acct field from auditd

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name of the process associated with the event if present
fields.justification: Enables process-based detection rules and behavioral analysis in 3x02

source_mapping.linux_text: program field or auditd comm field

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address of the event if present
fields.justification: Essential for network correlation, geolocation enrichment, and detecting lateral movement in 3x02

source_mapping.linux_text: addr field from auditd or parsed IP from syslog message

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address of the event if present
fields.justification: Essential for identifying communication targets and exfiltration detection in 3x02

source_mapping.linux_text: parsed IP from syslog message or null

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original raw log line or message before normalization
fields.justification: Provides forensic traceability back to the source evidence for incident reconstruction in 3x03

source_mapping.network_json: JSON serialization of the original record

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Windows event ID or null for non-Windows sources
fields.justification: Enables Windows-specific detection rules in 3x02 that key on known event IDs

fields.name: source_origin
fields.description: Provenance tag indicating whether the event came from the evidence pack or student telemetry
fields.justification: Maintains chain of custody for forensic integrity and distinguishes test data from production evidence

fields.name: source_channel
fields.description: Windows event channel such as Security, Sysmon, or PowerShell
fields.justification: Allows filtering by Windows logging subsystem in 3x02 detections

fields.name: source_provider
fields.description: Windows event provider name that generated the event
fields.justification: Helps distinguish between Microsoft and third-party event sources in detection rules

fields.name: pid
fields.description: Process ID associated with the event if present
fields.justification: Enables process tree reconstruction and parent-child correlation in 3x02 investigations

source_mapping.linux_text: pid field from syslog header or auditd pid key

fields.name: src_port
fields.description: Source port number for network events
fields.justification: Enables port-based correlation and service identification in network detection rules

fields.name: dst_port
fields.description: Destination port number for network events
fields.justification: Enables port-based detection rules and service identification in 3x02

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Network protocol such as TCP, UDP, or ICMP
fields.justification: Allows protocol-based filtering in detection rules and triage

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action taken by the source system such as ALLOW, BLOCK, or null
fields.justification: Critical for firewall and IDS event analysis in 3x02 to distinguish allowed vs blocked traffic

source_mapping.linux_text: res field from auditd (success or failed)

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Alert signature name from IDS or IPS systems
fields.justification: Enables signature-based detection correlation and threat intelligence matching in 3x02

fields.name: bytes_in
fields.description: Bytes received in the connection or flow
fields.justification: Supports bandwidth anomaly detection and data exfiltration analysis in 3x02

source_mapping.network_json: flow.bytes_toserver for suricata, bytes_total for pcap

fields.name: bytes_out
fields.description: Bytes sent in the connection or flow
fields.justification: Supports bandwidth anomaly detection and data exfiltration analysis in 3x02

source_mapping.network_json: flow.bytes_toclient for suricata, null for pcap

fields.name: event_data
fields.description: Original structured event data payload from the source system
fields.justification: Preserves vendor-specific fields for deep dive analysis without requiring re-parsing of raw logs

source_mapping.network_json: original JSON object excluding mapped fields

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Unique opaque identifier for the normalized record
fields.justification: Enables the timeline index in 3x10 to reference back to the full enriched record without storing duplicates
